tags.note: Pedestrians are no longer allowed to cross Yellowstone Avenue at this intersection.

The addition of the crossing=no tag is intended to prevent routers from guiding a pedestrian through this intersection incorrectly. It is suggested at https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Tag:highway%3Dtraffic_signals
